I am 19 yrs old and the girl i like is 18yrs. we r in a lovng relationship from 1.5 years. we talk over phone and almost evry weekend we go on long drive in my car. 3848 views Q. Is it permissible in Islam to hold Walima without Rukhsati, and can both families share Walima expenses? 12279 views Q. Nikah 2072 views Q. I married a girl in April 2009 and now I have a son by grace of Allah almighty. The problem started with the day of marriage as the the guest from my side were treated badly. But I maintained a neutral view towards every body and always advocated methods to reconcile and forget the past. But from past 6 months (since the birth of our child)the attitude of my in laws has changed and they have started using languages (threatened to kill me and my parents-specially my wifes aunt) . I Then also I told my parents and wife that only my wife maintain relationship with them and me and my family will not talk to them. My wife's dad came to our house and again started cursing my parents and my younger sister. I am really upset with all this thing and most hurtful is that my wife doesnot seem take a stand on who is right and who is wrong...even if I have asked her several times. This really angers me as being the only son to my parents I have a duty towards my parents...and the only way now seems to me is that I separate from my wife. My father is totally against this but I cannot go against my parents wish. Please advice what should be done in this regard. I too love my wife but I am not able to make her understand that loving her does not mean that I will take take any bad remarks for my family from her family.. Please advice that according to Shariah what is the best possible way available to me.. Seeking your dua and guiadance, Regards, Nayyar Rahman, Mob:- 91-9886748922 PS:- Is there any way to talk to you? 3204 views Q. Marriage in the month of Muharram 2829 views Q. What says Uluma-e-Karam in the light of Quran-o-Sunnah: There is a practice in our area according to which Nikah is done in proper Islamic way at the time of engagement but at the time of rukhsati, again Nikah is done in the same way. Uluma doing so admit the fact that once Nikah is done at the time of engagement, it is not necessary to repeat it at the time of rukhsati however they says it is better to repeat it ( or renew it ) at the time of rukhsati. It is necessary to mention here that it is an integaral part of the marriage ceremony in our area to arrange a function of doing nikah on the evening of Shabe-uroosi in which all close relatives participate. So if this function is not done, there would be confusion in the mind of relatives. My question is: ? whether this practice of repeating nikah is according to Quran-o-Sunnah and is there any evidence available in Sunnah. ? Is there any Hadees proving that this practice is forbidden. ? Then in case there is no evidence available in Sunah regarding allowing or disallowing, whether one can be allowed to repeat nikah for the sake of making people?s mind clear. 3766 views Q. answer: Social Matters >> Nikah (Marriage) Question ID: 4788 Country: Bangladesh Title: Marriage is expected to be performed after 1 month. Primary talks are done happily between two families. Regarding this situation, a local Aleem says: 1. Both the boy and girl can talk to each other over phone in the mean time since their marriage proposal is agreed between two families and a probable time-period is setup to finalize it. 2. It is also the Sunnah of Rasulullah (SAWS) to create a lovely period/situation between boy and girl before marriage. I would like to know, whether the answers given by the Aleem are right according to Islamic Shariah. Question: Assalamu-alaikum, Marriage is expected to be performed after 1 month. Primary talks are done happily between two families. Regarding this situation, a local Aleem says: 1. Both the boy and girl can talk to each other over phone in the mean time since their marriage proposal is agreed between two families and a probable time-period is setup to finalize it. 2. It is also the Sunnah of Rasulullah (SAWS) to create a lovely period/situation between boy and girl before marriage. I would like to know, whether the answers given by the Aleem are right according to Islamic Shariah. Zazakallahu Khairan. Answer ID: 4788 Posted on: Aug 31, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 1137/981=B-1429) The reply of the Aalim is not right. A betrothed before nikah is like a strange to whom talking is not allowed either face to face or over the phone. However, since nikah is for whole life and has many advantages, so if the boy wants to have a look at the girl before nikah , then it is allowed, as it is in the Haidth: قال رسول الله صلى الله عليه وسلم: إذخطب أحدكم المرأة فإن استطاع أن ينظر إلى ما يدعو إلى نكاحها فليفعل (ابو داؤد) Instead of seeing her yourself, it is better to send any experienced woman from amongst aunty (paternal or maternal) etc. Since a man can only see the face while a woman can see the face as well as she can gather other information about the way of living, atmosphere of the house etc. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
